issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'ngươi phải dùng nó đào hố, rồi lấp lại phân của mình' (you must use it to dig a hole, then cover your excrement), which is not present in the Hebrew verse. The Hebrew only says 'you shall have a peg outside the camp, and you shall go out there outside' — the digging and covering instructions appear in the following verse (Deut 23:13), not here.
